model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the ‘effect’ values for various language models, categorized by their linguistic family.  The horizontal axis displays the names of the language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, arranged in alphabetical order. The vertical axis, labeled ‘effect’, ranges from approximately 0 to 30 and utilizes a linear scale with tick intervals of 5 units, indicating values in increments of 5. Each bar represents a specific language model, with the bars colored differently to distinguish between mBERT-L2 (blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-L2 (pink), XLM-R2 (dark red), mBERT-B2 (purple), mBERT-B_R2 (brown), and mBERT-B_L2 (dark green). The mBERT-L2 bars have the highest values, with a peak of approximately 28, while the mBERT-B_L2 bars have the lowest values, around 3. The XLM-R2 bars are approximately 24, and the XLM-L2 bars are about 22.  Error bars, representing standard deviations, are present above each bar, indicating the variability in the ‘effect’ value for each language model.  No bars are visually emphasized, and the chart does not appear to be sorted in any particular order.
